collection.description: The work is finished, and a villager sits outside their hut at sunset thinking about the day.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: The work is finished. (name1) sits down outside (his/her) hut with a cup of something warm, and every part of (him/her) aches in a pleasant, ordinary, worn-out way. The sun is going down behind the trees. Somewhere children are being called home for dinner. Someone is laughing at the fire. (name1) thinks about everything (he/she) did today: not great things, just the usual things, done properly. (He/She) thinks about all the days before this one, a long line of them stretching back, most of them a bit like this. It isn't a remarkable life, perhaps. (name1) finishes (his/her) drink, stretches, and decides that it's a good one anyway.
